scope: Primary-source checks for the added related-work challenges; not an exhaustive novelty audit or experimental validation.

challenges.source_evidence: Reward misspecification risk; structural planning-policy mismatch and value overestimation.
challenges.our_inference: Check whether fixed candidates contain successful alternatives missed by the original score.

challenges.source_evidence: ContactGuard explicitly leaves post-abort recovery/completion and alternative action selection to future work; Foresight studies failure monitoring.
challenges.our_inference: Real alternative-action outcomes and closed-loop completion require evaluation beyond monitoring.

challenges.source_evidence: Value-guided action reranking exists; current-latent and corrupted-action ablations already exist.
challenges.our_inference: Match data, information, capacity and candidate budget to identify the incremental effect of frozen dynamics features in state-based TD-MPC2.

challenges.source_evidence: Cross-policy transfer is asymmetric and calibration depends on deployment distribution.
challenges.our_inference: Labels generated using a fixed continuation policy need not remain valid under continuous reranking; this is distinct from TD-M(PC)^2 policy-update mismatch.

challenges.source_evidence: World-model latency can limit on-device control; Sparse Imagination reduces visual-token prediction cost.
challenges.our_inference: Measure branch-interaction costs and added inference latency; a four-action state-based design is not a reproduction of visual token sparsification.
challenges.role: Feasibility constraint, not a standalone novelty claim.

contribution_types.C3: Proposed empirical mechanism study and reproducible evaluation protocol

important_boundaries: A good alternative must exist in the fixed candidate set; BMPC motivates investigating prior/value learning if coverage is inadequate.
Forecasting features are deterministic functions of available state/action, not additional future observations.
Continuous deployment mismatch remains unaddressed if E2 fails; no new-policy relabeling algorithm is claimed implemented.
ContactGuard and Foresight remain classified as 2026 preprints.
HAB contact-constraint extension remains conditional; no real-robot safety guarantee is claimed.
